text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I put on a run that captivated everyone! 
When I head to the press conference room 
where many reporters are waiting—

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The reporters are—one person! Plus, Doto!! 
Good grief... To think there are so many 
people on the brink of despair who still 
know nothing of me!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
My next goal has been decided: salvation! 
I'll turn the unfortunate souls who don't 
yet know me into fans with my run as the 
"Supreme Ruler"... got it?!
